questions.question: Build a global exception handler
questions.answer: Create consistent error responses without leaking stack traces.
questions.example: Middleware catches unhandled exceptions, logs a correlation id and maps known domain exceptions to safe status codes.
questions.followup: Follow-up: how do you test it?

questions.question: Build a JWT-secured API
questions.answer: Protect endpoints and enforce role/policy authorization.
questions.example: Authenticate token signature/claims, then authorize by policy rather than trusting a client-supplied role.
questions.followup: Follow-up: where do you store secrets?

questions.question: Build an Angular search page
questions.answer: Search as the user types without request storms.
questions.example: Reactive form valueChanges → debounceTime → distinctUntilChanged → switchMap → error handling and lifecycle cleanup.
questions.followup: Follow-up: what if the previous request returns late?

questions.question: Build pagination
questions.answer: Support page, size, total count and stable ordering.
questions.example: Validate page size, use deterministic ORDER BY and server-side pagination for large datasets.

questions.question: Build a retry component
questions.example: Classify errors, use bounded exponential backoff with jitter and cancellation; never blindly retry every failure.
questions.followup: Follow-up: how do you avoid retry storms?

questions.question: Design an audit logger
questions.answer: Record security/business events without exposing secrets.
questions.example: Use structured events with actor, action, resource, timestamp and correlation id; redact sensitive fields.
questions.followup: Follow-up: how do you prevent log tampering?

questions.question: A customer reports one screen is blank
questions.example: Reproduce with the same route/data, inspect browser console/network, compare API response, check feature flags and recent deployment, then isolate the failing boundary.
questions.followup: Follow-up: how do you communicate status to the customer?

questions.question: API works locally but fails in production
questions.answer: Compare environment contracts rather than changing code randomly.
questions.example: Inspect configuration, identity, network policy, certificates, dependency versions and data differences.
questions.followup: Follow-up: what telemetry should exist before the incident?

questions.question: Database CPU suddenly spikes
questions.answer: Correlate timing with queries and workload.
questions.example: Inspect top queries, execution plans, blocking, statistics, data growth and recent releases.
questions.followup: Follow-up: when is adding an index the wrong fix?

questions.question: A background job processes duplicates
questions.answer: Assume delivery can repeat and design for idempotency.
questions.example: Persist a stable job/event id and make state transitions conditional/atomic.

questions.question: Angular page becomes slow after adding a feature
questions.example: Profile rendering, network waterfall, bundle size, change detection and subscription behavior; fix the measured bottleneck.
questions.followup: Follow-up: how would you prevent regression?

questions.question: External payment provider is intermittently failing
questions.answer: Protect the system while preserving correctness.
questions.example: Use timeouts, classified retries, circuit breaking, idempotency and reconciliation rather than duplicate charges.
questions.followup: Follow-up: what must happen when provider outcome is unknown?
